verdict.rationale: The source is publicly readable: the product lives in a public GitHub repo, and users can copy its skill folders or paste any SKILL.md file directly into a chat. It also ships standard-library Python scripts such as contrast.py that users can inspect. Nothing in the evidence names a license, so the 'open license' half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: a stated open-source license (e.g. MIT/Apache), and independent confirmation of the licensing terms.
